meta.title: Context detail
meta.description: Adds a context strip above the composer and a Context panel in the right sidebar. The strip shows how much of the model window is in use, and its opposite side prints the prompt-cache hit of the last turn with the session rate beside it, both aligned with the composer box. Clicking either opens the panel, which splits the window into system prompt, tools, messages and free space. Tools is the real tool context: the definitions catalog attributed per MCP server and per plugin-provided tool, the arguments of every call, and the result content, with a per-tool breakdown. Messages is conversation only, split into your prompts, assistant responses and reasoning. It also lists the skill catalog, compactions with their input and summary sizes, added notices, session token usage with the prompt-cache hit rate of the last turn and of the session, and a context-growth sparkline with the newest requests. Every section below the headline collapses and starts closed. It reads projections and the session log only and makes no model requests, so it costs no tokens; totals are measured and the rows inside a category split that total in proportion to the text each part contributes.
